margin_basis: lower bound of the fit-era CI, data/atlas/view_fit_v1_1.json

slice.definition: sitting_cutter.is_bar_readable — fit_model==view_fit_v1.1 and fit_score and composite all present

attainable.why: AP is base-rate dependent; this is AP(perfect) - AP(worst) on THIS slice, the ceiling on any delta two orderings of these rows can produce.

verdict_qualifier: UNINFORMATIVE — the margin is 94% of the entire attainable delta-AP range on this slice, so NOT MET is not evidence against view_fit v1.1.
population_caveat: Native-plane multibrot MANEUVER views only (the slice carries no julia and no phoenix row). Any verdict is scoped to that population, not to the pipeline.
scope: SOURCING-side only. This module reads; it changes no order.
